page.content:
The Heartbreak Kid — show-stealer and D-Generation X co-founder.

How Shawn Michaels connects

  • Faction: D-Generation X — Shawn Michaels co-founded D-Generation X with Triple H.
  • Character: Bret Hart — Shawn Michaels and Bret Hart's feud ended in the Montreal Screwjob.

What is Shawn Michaels?

Shawn Michaels was the boyhood dream of the 1990s: WrestleMania classics, the Montreal chapter with Bret Hart, and the D-Generation X act that helped open the Attitude Era.

Key threads lead to D-Generation X and Bret Hart.
